notes: Extends login profile bootstrap timeouts so a valid password does not fail the release gate just because profile hydration is slow on preview.
Hardens release-gate workspace chooser handling so tests select the current QA workspace instead of getting stuck behind the chooser dialog.

Adds a partial-resume Play Store command that runs only the failed, timed-out, and not-run identities from the uploaded interrupted 16.0.175 release-gate run and excludes the 65 tests that already passed.
title: 86 Chaos 16.0.178
summary: Fixes slow preview login/workspace chooser release-gate failures and adds a partial-resume Play Store command that reruns only failed, timed-out, and not-run tests from the interrupted 16.0.175 run while excluding tests that already passed.
description: Fixes current release-gate blockers for mobile Schedule Builder visibility, Ghost Mode Request Off conflicts, and workspace-switch cost regression while adding a five-test blocker rerun command.
